title: ADR-001 - Supplier Connectivity via API Gateway
content:
# ADR-001

All external integrations must be routed through the new API Gateway. Direct database connections from external or non-gateway internal services are strictly prohibited to ensure security and auditability.
author: architect_01

title: Atlas Architecture Overview
content:
# Atlas Architecture

The Order Hub interfaces with external suppliers using the API Gateway. The legacy SAP SRM is accessed via outbound REST APIs.
author: architect_01

title: Atlas Integration Test Plan
content:
# Test Plan

Tests will validate the Order Hub connectivity to the SAP SRM and new Supplier portals.
author: qa_01

title: Atlas Production Readiness Checklist
content:
# Production Readiness Checklist

- Security Review: Pass
- Performance Testing: Pass
- UAT Sign-off: Complete
- Defect resolution: Ensure all critical bugs are fixed before go-live.
author: pm_01

title: Atlas API Design Guidelines
content:
# API Design Guidelines

REST APIs must follow OpenAPI 3.0 specification and implement standard OAuth2 flow.
author: architect_01
